holidays.name: First Chill
holidays.longDescription: First Chill is observed on day 1 of month 1 in the Snowdin Calendar. It is classified as a seasonal and is associated with Underground chill sets — puzzles freeze . Communities use the occasion to preserve local memory, reinforce shared identity, and mark the passage of the calendar year. Practices vary by region and faction, so this observance may carry different political or religious meaning across the wider world.
